column1: # SICP amb driver legs (.todo/856): one row per stream-free embedded-amb sample
# wired as a driver leg in SicpCorpusE2eTest#ambDrivers.
# The composed program is the same for every leg: the corpus support files
# minus its trailing (driver-loop) call, plus the harness glue
# Stdin per leg is the two corpus prelude files, then the sample; the glue loop's
# EOF clause ends the run, so no terminator form is appended and the legs stay
# in-process on every backend (an (exit) terminator would be System.exit on the
# Every leg runs INTERPRETER, JVM, WASM and WASM_COMPONENT; each backend must
# exit 0 with byte-identical stdout to the interpreter's (the same contract as
# a scheme/ok file). Column: sample (relative to programs_scm/).
